title: Observation
body_md: Observation $z^t_{n,f}$ of agent $\mathtt{A}_{n,f}$ at time $t$ consists of local channel gains of BS $n$'s users on subchannel $f$ normalized by the noise power and  total interference power experienced by the users of BS $n$. In practice, the total interference can be extracted from Reference Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) report \cite{3GPP5GNR}. Additionally, we assume available long-term system information which is also inputted to the agent, including network-wise user locations and the number of active users in all BSs. This practical and local observation model enables a \emph{fully distributed deployment} of the trained agents at every BS.
